 Killygordan is a small town in the east of the county. Approximately 25km from Letterkenny and 14km from Lifford it is a good commuter town. The town has basic amenities with independent shop, post office, school, and Sports & Recreational facilities. The nearest second level school is in nearby Raphoe or Stranorlar

From Killygordan head toward Railway Ave continue to follow N15 for 2.8km, turn right onto Liscooly for 950m turn right for 200m then turn left toward Meenlougher for 120m destination will be on the right. Input eircode F93 F2P2 into sat nav or smart phone to be taken to the property.
